notes:
ACCESS: same as the other two files - /shop/ paths 403 via curl_cffi/Playwright (Akamai), real Chrome via Claude-in-Chrome was the working route. NAVIGATION: main nav 'SALE' tab (https://www.westelm.com/shop/sale/) is itself a landing/hub page ('Labor Day Sale: Up to 70% Off' promo tiles by room/category: Furniture, Outdoor, Bedding, Lighting, Bath...), not a product grid. Sitemap (shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz) lists the real children: /shop/sale/all-sale/, /shop/sale/clearance/, /shop/sale/outlet-deals/, /shop/sale/labor-day-deals/, /shop/sale/deals-under-20/, /shop/sale/free-shipping/, plus per-room sale pages (sale-furniture, sale-bedding, etc. - generic room-filtered Sale, not Clearance). SALE-VS-CLEARANCE TEST APPLIED: opened all three top candidates live and compared their own page headers (proves the count is page-specific, not a recycled site-wide number): /shop/sale/all-sale/ = 'All Sale' H1, 2857 Items (generic markdown listing, EXCLUDED - no permanence/clearance signal, just current in-season discounts including the active 'Labor Day Sale' banner); /shop/sale/clearance/ = 580 Items, H1 'Clearance', own dedicated filter set (Category, Shop By Room, Product Type, Color, Width, Price) distinct from All Sale's filters - INCLUDED but flagged, see below; /shop/sale/outlet-deals/ = 944 Items, H1 'Open Box Outlet Deals' with on-page copy 'Save on sale items that have been opened and returned' - INCLUDED, no ambiguity (open-box/returned liquidation stock is a textbook Outlet concept, matches the brief's Outlet term directly, no seasonal/date tie in its copy or URL). CLEARANCE ROW AMBIGUITY: the /shop/sale/clearance/ page's own <title> tag reads 'Labor Day Clearance: Extra 20% Off | West Elm', tying the page's on-page framing to the current Labor Day promotional event, and it sits as one of several room/category tiles inside the general Sale hub rather than being called out as a standalone concept in the primary nav or llms.txt nav listing. Against that: the URL path /shop/sale/clearance/ is persistent and not date-specific, the on-page H1 plainly reads 'Clearance' (not 'Labor Day Sale'), and it has its own separate product set/count/filters from both All Sale (2857) and Outlet (944), i.e. it is not a mere alias of either. Genuinely uncertain whether the site's OWN taxonomy treats this as permanent clearance merchandising vs. a temporarily-relabeled slice of the current Labor Day campaign, so it is recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag per the brief rather than guessed either way. SCOPE: West Elm Kids/Baby's own sale hub (/shop/baby-kids-sale/, which does include a 'kids-clearance' child and whose meta title explicitly says 'Baby & Kids Furniture Clearance & Outlet') was treated as out of scope for this 'West Elm US' company row, same as the other two files.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 1 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
